substantive_evaluations.collective_statement_most_likely_to_succ: Candidate #5 (01__19559705-SUPPLEMENTAL-RESPONSE-RIGOROUS-10182026.tex) is selected by the panel of USPTO adjudicators as the document most likely to succeed. From an administrative and regulatory standpoint, Candidate #5 strikes the exact balance between statutory completeness and prosecutorial decorum required by the Office of Patent Application Processing (OPAP) and the Office of Petitions. It anchors its authority firmly in 37 CFR §§ 1.111, 1.121, and MPEP § 714.03 for supplemental submissions, while invoking MPEP § 710.02(e) for the correct netting of the previously paid 4-month extension fee ($998.00 under Fee Code 2254) against the 5-month fee ($1,358.00 under Fee Code 2255), cleanly resolving the $360.00 delta. Furthermore, Candidate #5 impeccably executes the preemptive cure required by 37 CFR § 1.125 for substitute specifications (incorporating the necessary 1.125(b) 'no new matter' certification and clear segregation of drawings, claims, and abstracts) while removing the erroneous government license clause to secure Small Entity status under 37 CFR § 1.27. Unlike Candidate #1, which adopts an unnecessarily combative tone ('Demand for Order of Clearance'), or Candidate #4, which relies on inappropriate civil litigation nomenclature ('Prayer for Relief'), Candidate #5 maintains an authoritative, objective, and legally precise posture that maximizes the likelihood of immediate clearance and issuance of an updated Filing Receipt.
